Tooltip_EPE_PacifiedZombieCarrier: Contains a living pacified zombie, its embedded Simple Cure, actual equipment, and physical subject record. Set it down to recreate the same pacified subject.
Tooltip_EPE_ZombieDescription: A readable physical record of a pacified zombie's appearance, worn equipment, and possessions. Keep it with the subject's items so the zombie or restored survivor can be recreated correctly.
